siya.brief: Siya, clean-shaven young adult heroine of Siyaraj and daughter of a fireworks maker. Lean, graceful, expressive side-view game character based on the two user identity references: warm medium-brown skin, long black hair tied back with a loose curl, tiny bindi, simple gold jewelry, marigold-orange sari with crimson red-and-gold pallu, readable hands and feet, holding one unlit sparkler. The approved Basic Rakshas image is a style reference only. Same identity and pose: use a slightly more angular pallu edge with one broad, simple geometric gold border motif; keep all ornament large and sparse.

robin.brief: Robin, Siya's bird companion: a small, original Indian-folk firebird inspired by Jatayu, the noble vulture-king of the Ramayana. Side view facing right, in flight, both wings raised high in a V, long tail plumes trailing down and back, talons tucked under the body. Vivid vermillion-red wings and back; each wing's long flight feathers tipped with cream and then emerald green; feathers decorated with small Madhubani-style dot and line patterns in marigold. A cream belly and a fluffy white ruff around the neck, like a vulture's. A noble head with a strongly hooked golden raptor beak, a sharp, friendly eye with a crimson eye-mask, and a curled golden crest. A fan of long marigold-gold and orange tail plumes. Slim, regal and colourful, with bold, clean shapes that read at a small size. Original design; the references guide mood and colours only.

basic-rakshas.brief: Basic rakshas enemy: an ordinary adult male demon footsoldier for Siyaraj, about player height, sturdy compact build with natural humanoid proportions. Use the supplied painting as identity and costume reference, translated into simple readable gameplay pixels. Preserve dark muted plum-purple skin, black swept-back hair, a bold curled black moustache, prominent hooked nose, stern comic eye and a small visible fang. Short simplified pointed marigold-gold crown with one hot-pink jewel, fitted short-sleeve gold tunic, hot-pink and coral dhoti gathered just below the knees, a short turquoise shoulder drape, a few chunky gold cuffs and anklets, bare feet. Reduce the painting's intricate ornament to two or three bold shapes. One small marigold-gold oval-headed mace with a short wooden handle, held low in the forward hand and pointing slightly forward; the other hand stays clearly visible. Keep the mace design identical across variants. Strict right-facing side profile, neutral alert idle stance with knees softly bent and both feet readable. Standard non-boss silhouette: modest crown, short drape, ordinary limb thickness, 246 native pixels total height including crown in the selected cleaned sprite. Simplify away the reference's long overhead staff, shield, sword and raised-arm battle pose. Keep skin color, face identity, outfit colors, crown and mace stable across all five variations. Same identity with slightly stronger geometric tailoring and one simple Madhubani-inspired border.

winged-forest-demon.brief: Winged forest demon creature for Siyaraj, adapted from attachment 1. A lean adult gargoyle-like imp with moss/olive-green skin, angular hunched torso, long pointed swept-back ears, two slim curved head horns, one sharp right-facing hooked muzzle, a single visible marigold eye and small ivory fang. Two arms with long three-fingered claws and two digitigrade legs with three-toed talons; exactly four limbs plus two separate bat wings. The near leathery bat wing rises behind the shoulders and arcs to the left/back, with three clear ribs and a scalloped lower edge; the far wing is partially visible offset behind it. Keep the head and forward claw unobscured in a strict right-facing profile. A compact alert crouch with both taloned feet at one baseline, elbows bent and forward claws lowered; no front-facing symmetric spread. Deep aubergine outline and dark olive wing membranes, lighter moss-green ribs, sparse hot-pink sash at the waist, one marigold wrist band and one tiny ivory skull charm hung at the waist. Natural sinewy anatomy, no armor, crown, mace or human clothing. Omit the painting background, branch, hanging bones and scenery. Total creature including wing tips is approximately 90 native pixels tall and 92 native pixels wide. Body without wings is about 60 native pixels tall. Keep horns, muzzle, eye, fang, claws and wing ribs as bold separated pixel clusters. Fixed across variants: green skin, face, horns, crouching anatomy, wing count, sash and charm. Only wing-edge shape, minimal accent motifs and facial expression may vary. Same identity with a slightly hooked upper wing tip and two deeper lower-edge scallops; spare marigold wrist band.

A HUGE black handlebar moustache with curled tips, twice the width of the face. Heavy eyebrows, smug expression. Three-quarter view facing slightly down. A short neck stub at the bottom.
